description: Candidate one-DGX Spark GLM 5.3 Flash text profile on antirez/ds4 with the imatrix Q2 GGUF resident in memory (about 90 GiB; antirez's DGX Spark guide gives this as the single-Spark target and runs it at 16K context). Q4 does not fit resident, and ds4 has no GLM Spark-to-Spark tensor parallelism. Vision (separate encoder GGUF) and DSpark are not part of this profile; MTP is an opt-in option as in the upstream guide. Memory is the loading floor (weights plus 8 GB runtime) with the 16K context included: an estimate that fits an idle Spark; the first hardware try measures it. Physical Spark acceptance is still required.
title: GLM 5.3 Flash DS4 Q2 single Spark
